data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement plugins/dso/scripts/scan-todo-comments.sh so all RED tests from the RED counterpart task pass.

**Why**: Provides the deterministic scanner that SC-1 disposition work depends on.

**Scope**: Single new script at plugins/dso/scripts/scan-todo-comments.sh. Must: walk plugins/dso/ honoring .gitignore; match TODO/FIXME/HACK/WORKAROUND via word boundaries; extract optional ticket reference; emit one JSON object per finding to stdout; classify disposition_hint.

## Acceptance Criteria

- plugins/dso/scripts/scan-todo-comments.sh exists, executable, has shebang #!/usr/bin/env bash and 'set -euo pipefail'
- All RED tests pass (GREEN state)
- Running against plugins/dso/ produces valid JSON parseable by 'jq -s .'
- Script honors .gitignore (no node_modules, .venv, etc.)
- No regressions in pre-existing test suite
data.title: GREEN: Implement scan-todo-comments.sh to pass RED tests
